metadata.title: Tadriss
metadata.description: School management for private institutions in Morocco: attendance, grades, timetables, fees and receipts in MAD.

hero.title: Your school, run with care.
hero.subtitle: Attendance, marks out of 20, timetables, fees and receipts in dirhams — in one place for administrators, teachers and students.

features.title: Everything a school runs, in one place.
features.body: No more paper registers, spreadsheets or handwritten receipts. Every module talks to the others.

attendance.title: Registers in thirty seconds
attendance.body: Present, absent, late, excused: one tap per student, on the web or on a phone. Absences reach the office instantly.

grades.title: Marks out of 20
grades.body: Configurable scales and coefficients, subject averages, report cards ready to print.

finance.title: Fees & receipts
finance.body: Monthly or annual invoices, allocated payments, numbered receipts, traceable voids.

schedule.title: Timetables
schedule.body: Periods, rooms and teachers: everyone sees their week, and changes reach everyone at once.

messages.title: Announcements & messages
messages.body: Broadcast to a class or the whole school, message students directly, and see who has read what.

documents.title: Documents
documents.body: Certificates, report cards and paperwork, filed per student and shared securely.

roles.title: Three workspaces, one school.
roles.body: Everyone sees exactly what they need — and nothing more.

languages.title: French by default, Arabic without compromise.
languages.body: In Arabic the whole interface flows right to left: menus, tables, forms and receipts. English is there for international teams.

security.title: Your school’s data stays yours.
security.body: Separation between schools is enforced by the database itself, not just the interface.

isolation.title: Strict isolation
isolation.body: Every query is filtered per school at the database level: one school never sees another’s data.

roles.title: Role-based access
roles.body: Teachers and students only see their own classes and their own data.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.body: Voided payments, sensitive edits: every important action is recorded.

cta.title: Ready for the new school year?
cta.body: Create your school’s workspace, then invite your teachers and students.

directionPreview.title: Choose a visual direction
directionPreview.intro: Four systems shaped by the research. Each proposal shows marketing, authentication and the admin workspace using the same product content.

a.name: Quiet Precision
a.body: A dense, fast workspace for making decisions without hunting.
a.featureBody: A strict grid, aligned numbers and one primary action at each step.

rationale.one: The hierarchy puts daily decisions first.
rationale.two: Quiet surfaces give school data room to breathe.
rationale.three: Shortcuts stay visible without turning the product into noisy control-room software.

b.name: Warm Editorial
b.hero: School work deserves room to breathe.
b.body: Clear stories, colour-coded modules and details that make the next step inviting.
b.featureBody: Attendance, grades and fees keep their colour inside a bright, layered composition.

rationale.one: An editorial voice makes welcome moments more memorable.
rationale.two: Module accents make the space easier to scan.
rationale.three: Cards keep a human warmth while preserving clear actions.

c.name: Contemporary Maghreb
c.body: Proportions inspired by thresholds and courtyards, serving a very concrete tool.
c.featureBody: The roll fills like a classroom board, then the day assembles around it.

rationale.one: Threshold and courtyard proportions create a local signature without folklore.
rationale.two: The Plex Arabic and Geist pairing stays legible in both scripts.
rationale.three: Sequenced transitions follow the rhythm of a school day.

d.name: Cinematic Studio
d.hero: Build your school before you create it.
d.body: Choose your context and watch a coherent Tadriss workspace assemble in front of you.
d.featureBody: A lightweight, accessible, video-free configurator: real DOM panels change position.

rationale.one: A configuration scene gives exploration a clear product reason.
rationale.two: DOM panels keep the experience fast, accessible, and indexable.
rationale.three: Depth supports orientation; it never becomes a show by itself.
